description: Claude Fable analyzes the request, recalls prior knowledge from the kaiba knowledge base, authors the design and implementation plan, Codex implements with GPT-5.6 Terra and independently reviews with GPT-5.6 SOL, Fable verifies completion, and a self-review step feeds durable lessons back into the knowledge base before the final output.

prompts.rielaPromptTemplate: Coordinate {{workflowId}}. Fable owns repository analysis, design, implementation-plan authoring, replanning, and final acceptance. Codex GPT-5.6 Terra owns implementation and improvement. An independent Codex GPT-5.6 SOL session owns implementation review. Loop blocking review findings back to Terra, route invalid plans back to Fable analysis, and finish only after Fable verifies the goal and the knowledge-base self-review has run.
prompts.workerSystemPromptTemplate: Return concise business JSON only. Preserve analysis, design and implementation-plan artifacts, changed files, verification evidence, review findings, remaining TODOs, and residual risks.

steps.description: Use Fable to analyze the operator request, repository state, constraints, risks, and testable acceptance criteria, and to name a knowledge-base search keyword.
Recall durable prior knowledge from the kaiba knowledge base for the analysis topic before design starts.
Use Fable to author or revise the design from the accepted analysis and recalled prior knowledge without implementing production code.
Use Fable to author or revise an actionable implementation plan from the accepted design.
Use Codex GPT-5.6 Terra to implement or improve the current Fable-authored plan and verify the result.
Use an independent Codex GPT-5.6 SOL session to review the implementation and request concrete fixes.
Use Fable to compare the accepted Codex result with the analysis, design, plan, and goal.
Use Fable to self-review the accepted run and extract at most one durable knowledge candidate for the knowledge base.
Recall existing knowledge-base notes related to the self-review candidate.
Use Fable to decide whether the candidate knowledge is created, merged into an existing note, or skipped.
Write the accepted candidate as a new kaiba knowledge-base note with graph auto-association.
Rewrite the existing kaiba note with the generalized merged body so the knowledge base absorbs the lesson without growing.
Publish the accepted Fable analysis, design, implementation plan, Codex evidence, knowledge-base update, and final status.

rielaPackage.title: fable-and-improve-codex
rielaPackage.description: Fable analyzes, designs, and plans with knowledge-base recall; Codex Terra implements; Codex SOL reviews; Fable verifies completion and self-reviews lessons into the knowledge base.
